title: Warehouse Annex Mine
subtitle: Crystal Minds and Shattered Souls, Obsidian Excavation Golems at the bottom

routes.name: To the deepest golem and portal

steps: Enter the Warehouse Annex Mine and keep to the left wall to reach the bottom.
Kill Obsidian Excavation Golems until one drops a Valara Crystal.
Take the portal near the golems back to the Warehouse.
Give Aun Talamura the Valara Crystal.

notes.title: Valara Crystal drop
notes.body: The game data gives each Obsidian Excavation Golem a 40% chance to drop a Valara Crystal. The quest guide says about 1 in 4 in practice, so expect a handful of kills.

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Obsidian Excavation Golems take full bludgeon (1.0) and 0.9 pierce, 0.53 slash. Fire and electric are 0.4, acid 0.2 and cold only 0.1.

notes.title: Pull one at a time
notes.body: Golems here go up to level 200 and there are about 80 of them. Pull them singly.

notes.title: Entry
notes.body: You need to be level 40 to use the entrance portal.
